title: Revision River Ferry Story Theme Card
themeSkill: Build a fictional story theme by connecting one story question, repeated clue, character choice, ending echo, theme line, and shelf marker note.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only theme card for one invented revision river ferry story: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: set out a blank story page, pencil, and pretend shelf marker strip; keep the ferry, river, and notes fully fictional: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a ferry guide who carries pretend revision notes across a made-up paper river, then fill each theme blank: ____________________.
storyQuestionPrompt: Story question: what does the ferry guide need to understand before the page can cross the revision river? ____________________.
repeatedCluePrompt: Repeated clue: choose one margin ripple, folded note, or ferry bell that appears more than once to point toward the theme: ____________________.
characterChoicePrompt: Character choice: write the choice the ferry guide makes when two pretend revision paths both seem possible: ____________________.
endingEchoPrompt: Ending echo: show how the ending quietly echoes the first river question without adding a new problem: ____________________.
themeLinePrompt: Theme line: write one simple sentence about what the ferry story suggests about careful changes: ____________________.
shelfMarkerNotePrompt: Shelf marker note: give this ferry theme a short pretend paper marker note: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the repeated clue, and the writer fills only the theme line blank: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the ferry theme card for one later adult-led offline paper pass: ____________________.
